en.askTitle: Tell it your computer, languages and workload, and get a measured pick for offline translation
en.runTitle: A small online shop with a 16 GB Apple-silicon Mac: four free offline translators tested head to head

fields.label: Computer, operating system and memory
fields.value: Apple-silicon Mac with 16 GB RAM shared with other work

fields.label: Source and target languages
fields.value: English, Spanish, German and Simplified Chinese

fields.label: Private or commercial use
fields.value: Commercial, for a small online shop; customer messages must stay on the machine

en.template: Help me choose a local translator for {machine}, {languages}, {volume} and {use}. Use these measurements only where relevant. Plan exact-model licence checks, an offline setup test and a fluent-reader check of numbers, negation and conditions. Ask before installing packages, downloading models, using stored credentials or uploading any text.

phases.title: Check the Mac, the current offline tools, the test texts and every licence
phases.note: Argos, OPUS-MT, NLLB, a small local language model and the Mac's built-in translation
phases.judgment: It would not accept a one-line licence summary. The Chinese Argos packages turned out to carry CC-BY-4.0 attribution notices, so a blanket "MIT/CC0" description was dropped. It also noted that matching file fingerprints only prove the copies are identical, not that they are authentic originals, and left that marked as unverified.

phases.title: Build the test set and run four translation engines one at a time under the 6 GB memory cap
phases.note: Public test sentences with reference translations, plus the shop's own sample text

phases.title: Score every result, then have a separate reviewer recompute the scores
phases.judgment: A second colleague wrote its own scoring program without seeing the first one or any test sentence, then recomputed all 40 scores: no mismatches. The run also owned up to a slip of its own: the first model downloads had picked up an old saved login, so the "no accounts" rule was not fully met. It said so in the report instead of claiming a clean run.

phases.title: Open the report at desktop and phone widths and deliver

workers: Checked each candidate's licence on its official page, whether the Mac's built-in translation can run without a window, and where the test sentences and downloads come from
Independently reviewed the results: wrote a separate scoring program without seeing the main one or any test sentence, then recomputed every score

zh.askTitle: 告诉它你的电脑、语言和用量，就能得到一份实测过的离线翻译推荐
zh.runTitle: 一家小网店、一台 16 GB 内存的苹果芯片 Mac：四款免费离线翻译工具同场实测

fields.label: 电脑、操作系统和内存
fields.value: 苹果芯片 Mac，16 GB 内存，还要和其他工作共用

fields.label: 源语言和目标语言
fields.value: 英语、西班牙语、德语和简体中文

fields.label: 个人或商业用途
fields.value: 商业用途，小网店；客户消息必须留在本机

zh.template: 帮我为 {machine}、{languages}、{volume}、{use} 选择本地翻译工具。只在适用时参考这些测量结果，规划具体模型授权核对、离线安装测试，以及由懂目标语言的人检查数字、否定和条件的步骤。安装软件包、下载模型、使用已保存凭据或上传任何文本前，先问我。

phases.title: 查看这台 Mac、当前可用的离线工具、测试文本和每一项授权
phases.note: Argos、OPUS-MT、NLLB、小型本地语言模型，以及 Mac 自带翻译
phases.judgment: 它没有满足于一句话的授权概括。Argos 的中文语言包带有 CC-BY-4.0 署名要求，所以「一律 MIT/CC0」的说法被删掉了。它还指出：文件指纹一致只能证明副本相同，不能证明就是原始官方文件，并把这一点标成未核实。

phases.title: 建立测试集，在 6 GB 内存上限内逐个运行四个翻译引擎
phases.note: 带参考译文的公开测试句，加上网店自己的样例文本

phases.title: 给每个结果打分，再由另一位同事独立重算分数
phases.judgment: 另一位同事在没看过第一套评分程序、也没看过任何测试句的情况下自己写了评分程序，把 40 个分数全部重算一遍，没有出入。这次运行还承认了自己的一处疏漏：最初下载模型时用到了电脑里旧的登录凭据，「不用账号」的规则没有完全做到，报告里如实写明，没有说成毫无瑕疵。

phases.title: 在电脑和手机宽度下打开报告检查，然后交付

workers: 在官方页面核对各候选工具的授权，查 Mac 自带翻译能否不开窗口运行，并查明测试句和下载文件的来源
独立复核结果：在没看过主评分程序和任何测试句的前提下另写评分程序，重算每一个分数
